notes: Access: direct HTTP (curl_cffi chrome-impersonate) and Playwright/Chromium both got Akamai 'Restricted Access' 403 on every /shop/ path (homepage alone returned 200), confirming the prior pass's note that this host runs anti-bot blocking on category pages. Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) per brief; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (only EasouSpider/Pinterestbot named). Claude-in-Chrome reached /shop/ pages (200) but the extension's IP geolocated as India, triggering PB's geo-splash ('There are no products available in your location') that hides all products; dismissed via the page's own 'No thanks, I'd like to proceed to the US site' link, after which full US product listings rendered normally. Checked: shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (794 top-level shop URLs) for 'pet' matches, the live top nav (New/Furniture/Outdoor/Bedding/Bath/Lighting/Rugs/Windows/Pillows&Decor/Art&Mirrors/Tabletop&Bar/Storage/Holidays/Gifts/Sale - no dedicated Pets tab), the Storage mega-menu (single leaf 'Pet Beds & Accessories' under Storage Accessories, no further pet sub-branches), and site search for 'pet' (80 results - not used for qty, over-inclusive/non-authoritative per brief). Pottery Barn has exactly one formal Pet Care taxonomy node: Storage > Pet Beds & Accessories (breadcrumb 'Storage / Pet Beds & Accessories'), a single flat PLP mixing pet beds, pet bowls, pet food/treat canisters, a dog crate, pet throws/blankets, and pet storage baskets - 20 Items per its own rendered header, exact match against the 20 named products enumerated on the page. A second page, Gifts > 'For The Pet Lover' (https://www.potterybarn.com/shop/gifts/gifts-for-the-pet-lover/, 15 Items), was found and excluded: it is a Gifts-nav marketing/curated collection (excluded category per brief) containing a subset of the same products already counted in Pet Beds & Accessories, not a distinct taxonomy branch - not emitted as a separate row to avoid double-counting. No pet food/consumable-only category and no medical/veterinary pet category found on the site.
